name: game-rules-manager
description: A 📜 Game Rules button on your game's HUD opens a panel for your build rules, saved as files: All games, Only this game, and Not in this game. Reorder rules, edit them inline, delete with a confirmation, switch light or dark theme, and export or import .zip (JSON + Markdown). When installed, it asks Savi to add the button to your HUD and fill the rules from your notes. Also available as a tab in god mode.
